name: 365-Day Devotional Journey

core_positioning.one_liner: A year-long devotional journey with one verse per day, weekly themes, and a gentle formation rhythm.
not_just: not just a standard 365-day Bible reading checklist
not just a random devotional every day
not just a long plan with no inner rhythm
is_actually: a daily one-verse entry with varied devotional form
a gradual movement from first trust to steadier spiritual maturity

annual_rhythm.goal: Make the plan feel like a full-year faith journey rather than 365 isolated entries.

formation_arc.focus: Move the user from unfamiliarity or instability into trust, God's presence, faith, prayer, and hope.
Lead the user into guidance, peace, gratitude, love, patience, wisdom, obedience, and humility.
Help the user live through trials, perseverance, courage, self-control, serving, temptation, repentance, forgiveness, grace, and renewal.
Bring the user toward surrender, waiting, endurance, protection, contentment, generosity, salvation, eternal hope, rest, truth, and finishing well.

weekly_rhythm.goal: Give each week a spiritual center so users are not starting from zero every day.

daily_form.goal: Keep the plan lightweight enough for daily return while preserving inner variety.

content_messaging.hero_title: A 365-Day Devotional Journey for Real Life
content_messaging.hero_subtitle: One verse per day, weekly themes, and a gentle formation rhythm that can carry a full year.
benefit_points: Turns a long devotional plan into a guided faith journey
Builds continuity through weekly themes instead of isolated days
Leads users from first trust into deeper steadiness over time
Keeps daily devotional reading small enough to return to consistently
Creates variety through different daily devotional forms
Makes growth feel gradual, not abrupt or overloaded

comparison_points.label: 365 devotional journey
comparison_points.value: formation arc, weekly themes, daily devotional form

article_angles: Why a 365-day devotional journey feels different from a regular reading plan
A year of devotionals: annual rhythm, weekly themes, and daily form
Why one verse per day can still carry a full devotional year
notes: This config is for website positioning and content planning, not the app runtime plan definition.
Here, annual rhythm means a year-long spiritual formation arc, not a liturgical calendar or holiday schedule.
If later needed, the structure can be expanded with richer phase labels, sample weekly themes, and UI copy variants.
